verdict.rationale: Ashby's own comparison page says it ships a native Scheduling module as part of its all-in-one platform, and its webhooks reference interview scheduling events. Nothing in the pack shows automatic scheduling of multi-interviewer panels or full onsite loops. missing for 10: documented automatic panel/onsite loop scheduling, interviewer load balancing, room booking, conflict resolution, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, multi-interviewer panels and full onsite loops schedule automatically — interviewer load balancing, room booking, and conflict resolution included

citations.quote: Ashby's All-in-One Recruiting platform combines your ATS, Scheduling, CRM & Sourcing, and Analytics into one powerful tool.
enabling automated responses to events like candidate status changes, job posting updates, or interview scheduling.
